content.short: Zyfi is a Paymaster-as-a-Service on ZKsync and Base enabling gasless transactions with any ERC-20 token.
content.description:
Zyfi is a pioneering decentralized infrastructure protocol designed to simplify the Web3 user experience through advanced Native Account Abstraction (ERC-4337). The platform provides a professional-grade "Paymaster-as-a-Service" that allows decentralized applications to offer gasless transactions, enabling users to pay for network fees using any of over 80 supported ERC-20 tokens instead of native ETH. This approach significantly lowers the barrier to entry for retail participants and fosters mass adoption by making on-chain interactions as intuitive as traditional web apps.

Operating across major networks including ZKsync and Base, Zyfi serves as a vital infrastructure layer for high-throughput DeFi, gaming, and social platforms. The protocol also features the ZyFAI autonomous agent, which utilizes AI to identify and execute optimal yield-farming strategies for its users. Through its commitment to user-centric design and technical innovation, Zyfi is building the essential framework for a more accessible and efficient decentralized economy, where gas management is a transparent and automated utility.
content.meta: Zyfi provides gasless transaction infrastructure and account abstraction tools for the ZKsync and Base networks.
